title: Country thread batch C1: PC-Globe-style country viewer Factbook source register
scope: Seed register for the country viewer (docs/agent-backlog-2026-10-21.md stream S4: 'PC-Globe-style country viewer with CIA Factbook notes'). Fields are extracted verbatim from the CIA World Factbook as mirrored by factbook/factbook.json at a pinned upstream commit; every seeded file carries its SHA-256 so the extraction is re-verifiable. This is a starter set (25 countries), not full Factbook coverage; the raw upstream files are not committed.
